chunks: Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd narrated to me from Salamah, from Mūsā ibn ‘Umar, from Ḥassān [Ghassān] al-Baṣrī, from Mu’āwiyah ibn Wahb, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Do not neglect the Ziyārah of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him). Do you not like to be among those for whom the angels pray?

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq)
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Al-Husayn (the third Imam, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.زِيَارَةَ: Ziyarah (visitation, specifically to shrines of Imams and prophets)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of performing Ziyarah to Imam al-Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Ṣādiq (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imām al-Ḥusayn (a.s.) from a mere ritual to a means of securing divine intercession, specifically noting that angels pray for those who make this pilgrimage. This highlights the Shia theological emphasis on the cosmic significance of the Ahl al-Bayt, where physical devotion translates into spiritual elevation and communal blessing recognized by the heavenly host.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd narrated to me from Salamah, from Mūsā ibn ‘Umar, from Ghassān Al-Basri, from Mu’āwiyah ibn Wahab, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Do not neglect going to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.). Do you not like to be among those for whom the angels pray?!
